title: Splits
summary: Costs you share with a partner, flatmates or friends: who paid, your share, and settling up. Each person's line says what comes back to you or goes back to them, and their splits close by themselves when you are square. Mark a Ledger line as shared and its split is written for you.
changes: Says plugin where it said add-on, as the app now does. Nothing it reads or writes changed.
